name: HMND 01
summary: HMND 01 Alpha is a wheeled humanoid from London startup Humanoid, built for warehouse, logistics and factory picking. It is 220 cm tall with 29 DoF, a 15 kg payload and an average 4-hour runtime. It is in early access with partners such as Schaeffler and Siemens, and a bipedal version is in development.
sensors: 360-degree RGB cameras and two depth sensors in the head, wrist RGB cameras, 6-axis force/torque sensors, haptic sensors.
compute: KinetIQ AI stack on NVIDIA compute.
highlights: Company says hardware was built in seven months.
Bin-picking trial at a Schaeffler factory; Bosch named as contract manufacturer.
Humanoid raised a $152 million Series A in July 2026.
caveats: Wheeled base; the bipedal version is still in development.
No public price; offered as early access and robots-as-a-service.

sources.title: U.K.-based startup Humanoid unveils HMND 01 Alpha mobile manipulator
U.K.-based Humanoid secures $152M in Series A funding
